arxiv-2108-09333.title: Dynatomic polynomials, necklace operators, and universal relations for dynamical units
arxiv-2108-09333.creator: John R. Doyle, Paul Fili, Trevor Hyde
arxiv-2108-09333.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by John R. Doyle, Paul Fili, Trevor Hyde. Introduction

Let
f(x)\in K[x]
be a polynomial with coefficients in a field
K
. For an integer
k\geq 0
, we denote by
f^{k}(x)
the
k
-fold iterated composition of
f
with itself. The
d
th dynatomic polynomial
\Phi_{f,d}(x)\in K[x]
of
f
is defined by the product

\Phi_{f,d}(x):=\prod_{e\mid d}(f^{d/e}(x)-x)^{\mu(e)},

where
\mu
is the standard number-theoretic Möbius function on
\mathbb{N}
. We refer the reader to
[
12
, §4.1]
for background on dynatomic polynomials.

arxiv-2112-14631.title: Quantum Toroidal Comodule Algebra of Type 𝑨 𝒏 − 𝟏 \boldsymbol{A_{n-1}} and Integrals of Motion
arxiv-2112-14631.creator: Boris FEIGIN ab, Michio JIMBO c and Evgeny MUKHIN d
arxiv-2112-14631.description: Abstract We introduce an algebra 𝒦 n \mathcal{K}_{n} which has a structure of a left comodule over the quantum toroidal algebra of type A n − 1 A_{n-1} . Algebra 𝒦 n \mathcal{K}_{n} is a higher rank generalization of 𝒦 1 \mathcal{K}_{1} , which provides a uniform description of deformed W W algebras associated with Lie (super)algebras of types BCD.

arxiv-2205-13084.creator: Mingxuan Lu, Zhichao Han, Susie Xi Rao, Zitao Zhang, Yang Zhao, Yinan Shan, Ramesh Raghunathan, Ce Zhang, Jiawei Jiang
arxiv-2205-13084.description: Abstract . Detecting fraudulent transactions is an essential component to control risk in e-commerce marketplaces. Apart from rule-based and machine learning filters that are already deployed in production, we want to enable efficient real-time inference with graph neural networks (GNNs), which is useful to catch multihop risk propagation in a transaction graph.

arxiv-2305-06605.title: Probable brown dwarf companions detected in binary microlensing events during the 2018-2020 seasons of the KMTNet survey
arxiv-2305-06605.creator: Cheongho Han, Youn Kil Jung, Doeon Kim, Andrew Gould, Valerio Bozza, Ian A. Bond (Leading authors) Sun-Ju Chung, Michael D. Albrow, Kyu-Ha Hwang, Yoon-Hyun Ryu, In-Gu Shin, Yossi Shvartzvald, Hongjing Yang, Weicheng Zang, Sang-Mok Cha, Dong-Jin Kim, Hyoun-Woo Kim, Seung-Lee Kim, Chung-Uk Lee, Dong-J
arxiv-2305-06605.description: Abstract Aims. We inspect the microlensing data of the KMTNet survey collected during the 2018–2020 seasons in order to find lensing events produced by binaries with brown-dwarf companions. Methods. In order to pick out binary-lens events with candidate BD lens companions, we conduct systematic analyses of all anomalous lensing events observed during the seasons.

arxiv-2310-10392.title: Distributed Differential Graphical Game for Control of Double-Integrator Multi-Agent Systems with Input Delay
arxiv-2310-10392.creator: Hossein B. Jond
arxiv-2310-10392.description: Abstract This paper studies cooperative control of noncooperative double-integrator multi-agent systems (MASs) with input delay on connected directed graphs in the context of a differential graphical game (DGG). In the distributed DGG, each agent seeks a distributed information control policy by optimizing an individual local performance index (PI) of distributed information from its graph neighbors.

arxiv-2407-17390.title: T 5 ​ S ​ c ​ o ​ r ​ e T^{5}Score : A Methodology for Automatically Assessing the Quality of LLM Generated Multi-Document Topic Sets
arxiv-2407-17390.creator: Itamar Trainin, Omri Abend
arxiv-2407-17390.description: Abstract Using LLMs for Multi-Document Topic Extraction has recently gained popularity due to their apparent high-quality outputs, expressiveness, and ease of use. However, most existing evaluation practices are not designed for LLM-generated topics and result in low inter-annotator agreement scores, hindering the reliable use of LLMs for the task.

arxiv-2412-03256.title: Electrode and electroactive polymer layout design using topology optimization
arxiv-2412-03256.creator: Daniel Hård, Mathias Wallin, Matti Ristinmaa
arxiv-2412-03256.description: Abstract When electrically stimulated, electroactive polymers (EAPs) respond with mechanical deformation. The goal of this work is to design electrode and EAP layouts simultaneously in structures by using density-based, multi-material topology optimization. In this novel approach the layout of electrodes and EAP material are not given a priori but is a result from the topology optimization.

arxiv-2507-05187.title: Infrastructuring Contestability: A Framework for Community-Defined AI Value Pluralism CCS: Human-centered computing Human computer interaction (HCI) CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative and social computing
arxiv-2507-05187.creator: Andreas Mayer
arxiv-2507-05187.description: Abstract . The proliferation of AI-driven systems presents a fundamental challenge to Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and Computer-Supported Cooperative Work (CSCW), often diminishing user agency and failing to account for value pluralism. Current approaches to value alignment, which rely on centralized, top-down definitions, lack the mechanisms for meaningful contestability ( Alfrink et al. 2023 ) .

arxiv-2508-20343.title: When Dephasing Fails: Thermodynamic Consequences of Decoherence Models in Quantum Transport
arxiv-2508-20343.creator: E. Erdogan, J. P. Bergfield*
arxiv-2508-20343.description: Abstract Understanding how decoherence influences heat and information flow is essential for realizing the promise of quantum technologies. Two widely used models for incorporating decoherence in quantum transport are the voltage probe (VP), which imposes local charge current conservation, and the voltage–temperature probe (VTP), which also conserves heat current.
